summary.text: New Argive is the northern Dominarian realm formed from Kjeldor and Balduvia after the Ice Age, whose walls and fortifications have long guarded it.

bio.text: After the Thaw, Darien and Lovisa ended their fighting and merged their nations into New Argive, with the marriage of Alexandrite and Lothar creating its royal house.
The Sheoltun Empire conquered New Argive and was later pushed out by the Argivians with the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels.
The Cult of Rimewind's attempt to undo the Thaw failed, New Argive secured control, and the Order of Stromgald was defeated.
At New Argive, Rith let four dragon lords incinerate themselves with mana so that Treva was reborn, and Darigaaz forbade further mortal sacrifices.
The second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion devastated New Argive, which recovered but then faced infiltration by Cabal agents.
In 2022, King Darien tasked Stenn with finding Phyrexian sleeper agents, and Stenn told Karn that New Argive would mobilize.
Raff healed Teferi of a grave Phyrexian wound in the watchtower of New Argive.

status.text: The latest events show New Argive preparing to mobilize against the Phyrexians under King Darien, with Raff healing Teferi in its watchtower.
